seo.title: Pure Clipboard — PURE
seo.description: Pure Clipboard is a native macOS app with an optional clipboard history that is off by default and stays on your Mac.
seo.ogDescription: Clipboard history for macOS. Off until you turn it on. Nothing leaves your Mac.

heroCaption: A real app window with sample data. It does not read your clipboard or account.
intro: Pure Clipboard remembers what you copied and puts it back with one click. It is a native macOS app with no account, no cloud and no analytics.

features.title: Clipboard history
features.text: Text, rich text, images, PDFs, and files or folders from Finder, including multiple selections. For files only a link to the original is stored, never a copy.

features.title: Search and restore
features.text: Find an item by word, app or file name and put it back on the clipboard with one click. If an original is gone, the app says so plainly.

features.title: Under your control
features.text: Default limits: 100 items and 30 days. Set the size of an item and of the whole store, pause the history, delete one item or everything.

features.title: Skips what is sensitive
features.text: Content marked private or transient by a password manager is never stored. Text is checked for passwords, keys and tokens before it is saved.

features.title: AI and terminal on request
features.text: Optionally copies the final answer from Claude Code and Codex CLI, or a command's output through pclip. Termux on your phone transfers text only when you run a command.

features.title: Pure Remote
features.text: An overview of Tailscale connections between this Mac and your devices. It reads local state only and stores nothing.

features.title: Transfers to the phone
features.text: Send files from the Mac to the phone's Downloads folder and back, in chunks and resumable. SHA-256 check, nothing overwritten.

privacy: The history is off by default. The clipboard is watched only after you explicitly turn it on, and only while the app is running.
Everything stays on this Mac in files readable only by you. Content and diagnostics are never sent to the cloud, and the app has no network code.

Images and PDFs are stored only after a separate consent. Before saving, the app scans them with on-device text recognition (OCR). OCR cannot find everything, so we do not promise that no secret can pass through an image.
Sensitive-data protection is a helper, not a guarantee. When in doubt, an item is not stored.
requirements: A Mac with an Apple chip (Apple silicon).
macOS 14 or later. Tested on macOS 27; older versions are not verified yet.
Intel Macs are not supported yet.
installIntro: Once the signed release is available, installation will be simple:
install: Download the .dmg and verify its SHA-256 (the value will be shown next to the link).
Open the image and drag Pure Clipboard to the Applications folder.
Launch the app from Applications. No feature turns itself on.
installNote: Today only a test build signed ad hoc exists; it is not an official download.

faq.q: Does Pure Clipboard watch my clipboard?
faq.a: Only when you turn the history on, and only while the app is running. By default the history is off and the clipboard is not watched.
In ~/Library/Application Support/PureClipboard on your Mac. Nothing is sent over the internet.

faq.q: Are passwords from a password manager stored?
faq.a: No. Content marked private or transient is skipped. Text is also checked for passwords and tokens, but reliable detection cannot be guaranteed.

faq.q: Are copies of my files stored?
faq.a: No. From Finder only a link to the original is stored. If the original disappears, the app shows it.
They are stored only after a separate consent and an on-device OCR check. OCR does not recognise handwriting, QR codes or secrets that are not text, so enable this deliberately.

faq.q: Does it work on Intel Macs, Windows or Android?
faq.a: No. Apple silicon with macOS 14 or later is supported. Other platforms are not verified yet.
Not yet. The signed and notarized release is waiting for a paid Apple Developer account. Until then it is not offered for download.

items: File transfer to and from the phone (Pure Remote): sent in chunks over ADB, with pause and resume without starting over, SHA-256 verification, and no overwriting of existing files.
Quick clipboard history with the ⌥⌘V shortcut: search and select, Enter copies to the clipboard, nothing is pasted automatically.
macOS notifications when a transfer finishes, fails, or waits for mobile data or the phone.
Photos and videos sent to the phone appear in Gallery; test ad-hoc build, not notarized yet.
System clipboard history (off by default): text, rich text, images, PDFs, files and folders as links.
Search, restore to clipboard, delete, pause and limits.
Sensitive-data protection, respect for transient-content markers, on-device OCR for images and PDFs.
Termux: text transfer between phone and Mac on explicit command.
Pure Remote: Tailscale traffic overview. Distribution groundwork.
Configuration, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Apple Terminal (pclip) and manual copying.
